questions.stem: A village must set harvest timing; who likely decided it?

options.text: The village assembly by custom.
The king's chancellor.
Only the parish priest.
A foreign merchant.

questions.explanation: Harvest timing was typically settled by village custom and assembly, not by distant officials.
